rows.text: I feel you haven't been back to the Express since forever, [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Didn't we just see each other?
It hasn't been that long since we last said goodbye, right?
Mmm... It has been a while. I'm starting to forget what Pom-Pom looks like
Come back when you've got the time. Pom-Pom has some things for you
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom
